fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects requests to exclude files, folders or processes from Antivirus scanning using PowerShell cmdlets
fields.name: Powershell Defender Exclusion
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "Add-MpPreference " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "Set-MpPreference ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -ExclusionPath " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -ExclusionExtension " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -ExclusionProcess " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -ExclusionIpAddress ")))
